name: Bousaid AI Slug Generator
author: tonogata

sections.description:
Perfect for non-English blogs (Japanese, etc.)! Bousaid AI Slug Generator is a powerful WordPress plugin that leverages Google Gemini AI to automatically generate SEO-friendly English post slugs from your native language titles.
Say goodbye to manual slug creation and let AI optimize your permalinks for better search engine visibility.

Main Features

  • Two Operation Modes
    • Easy Mode: Automatically generate slugs seamlessly. The plugin instantly analyzes your post title and content to provide the most suitable slug.
    • Advanced Mode: Granular control over the context sent to the AI. Choose exactly which post elements (Title, Excerpt, Content, Categories, Tags) are used to generate the slug, ensuring perfect alignment with your SEO strategy.
  • Direct API Integration: Connects directly to the Google Gemini API (Free tier available). Generate high-quality slugs efficiently without the need for expensive third-party middleman subscriptions.
  • Universal Editor Support: Completely compatible with both the modern Gutenberg Block Editor and the Classic Editor.
  • Zero Frontend Impact: The plugin operates strictly in the WordPress admin backend. There are absolutely no assets, scripts, or queries loaded on your public website, guaranteeing zero impact on your frontend performance and page speed.
  • Smart Sanitization: Responses from the AI are automatically sanitized, extracting only the valid slug and formatting it to perfectly match standard WordPress URL conventions.

Disclaimer

While this plugin is designed to work efficiently within the Google Gemini API’s free tier quotas, you must provide your own API key. The plugin author is not responsible for any unpredictable API charges or billing issues you may incur. Please monitor your Google Cloud Console usage regularly to ensure you stay within your desired limits. Use the API at your own risk.

External services

This plugin relies on the Google Gemini API (Generative Language API) as a third-party external service to generate the SEO-friendly slugs.
– Purpose: The plugin sends the post title and, optionally (if configured by the user), the post content, excerpt, categories, and tags to the Gemini API to analyze the context and return a suitable URL slug.
– Data Transmission: Data is only sent when the user explicitly clicks the “Generate AI Slug” button in the post editor, or when verifying the API key in the settings page.
– Service Provider: Google LLC.
– Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Usage

  1. Open any Post or Page in the WordPress editor.
  2. Look for the Bousaid AI Slug Generator panel:
    • Block Editor (Gutenberg): Located in the right sidebar settings panel.
    • Classic Editor: Located in the meta box on the right side.
  3. Click the Generate AI Slug button. The AI will generate a slug based on your title and context.
  4. Review the generated slug in the preview box.
  5. Click Apply to Post URL to officially save it to your post.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.
  6. Generate a Google Gemini API Key from the Google AI Studio.
  7. In your WordPress admin menu, navigate to Settings > Bousaid AI Slug Generator.
  8. Enter your Gemini API key in the settings page and save changes.
  9. You are ready to generate AI slugs within the post editor!
sections.faq:
Is it completely free?

The plugin itself is completely free. It uses the Google Gemini API for slug generation. Google offers a generous free tier for the Gemini API, which is typically more than enough for normal blog usage. However, standard usage limits and quotas apply. Exceeding them or changing your Google Cloud billing settings may result in charges from Google. Please review Google’s pricing policies and monitor your own API usage.

Which languages are supported?

The plugin interface is fully translation-ready and supports multiple languages. Regarding the AI generation, Gemini AI can understand content written in numerous languages and will generate appropriate SEO-friendly, URL-safe English/alphanumeric slugs based on the context of your non-English content.
